name: FiniteMultiplicity.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd
statement: FiniteMultiplicity a b) : ∃ c : α, b = a ^ multiplicity a b * c ∧ ¬a ∣ c

name: Nat.finiteMultiplicity_iff
statement: ℕ} : FiniteMultiplicity a b ↔ a ≠ 1 ∧ 0 < b

have_tree.name: ha
have_tree.body: fun ha => hb <| zero_dvd_iff.mp <| by rw [ha] at h; exact h 1

name: emultiplicity_add_of_gt
statement: α} (h : emultiplicity p b < emultiplicity p a) : emultiplicity p (a + b) = emultiplicity p b

name: finiteMultiplicity_mul_aux
statement: α} (hp : Prime p) {a b : α} : ∀ {n m : ℕ}, ¬p ^ (n + 1) ∣ a → ¬p ^ (m + 1) ∣ b → ¬p ^ (n + m + 1) ∣ a * b | n, m => fun ha hb ⟨s, hs⟩ => have : p ∣ a * b

name: multiplicity_mul
statement: α} (hp : Prime p) (hfin : FiniteMultiplicity p (a * b)) : multiplicity p (a * b) = multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b

have_tree.name: hdiv
have_tree.type: p ^ (multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b) ∣ a * b

have_tree.name: hsucc
have_tree.type: ¬p ^ (multiplicity p a + multiplicity p b + 1) ∣ a * b

name: multiplicity_eq_zero_of_coprime
statement: ℕ} (hp : p ≠ 1) (hle : multiplicity p a ≤ multiplicity p b) (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) : multiplicity p a = 0
